item.title: Claude Platform release notes — January 31st, 2025
item.description: • We've moved our Java SDK from alpha to beta.

item.title: Claude Platform release notes — January 23rd, 2025
item.description:
• We've launched citations capability in the API, allowing Claude to provide source attribution for information. Learn more in Citations.
  • We've added support for plain text documents and custom content documents in the Messages API.

item.title: Claude Platform release notes — January 21st, 2025
item.description: • We announced the deprecation of the Claude 2, Claude 2.1, and Claude Sonnet 3 models. Read more in Model deprecations.

item.title: Claude Platform release notes — January 15th, 2025
item.description:
• We've updated prompt caching to be easier to use. Now, when you set a cache breakpoint, we'll automatically read from your longest previously cached prefix.
  • You can now put words in Claude's mouth when using tools.

item.title: Claude Platform release notes — January 10th, 2025
item.description: • We've optimized support for prompt caching in the Message Batches API to improve cache hit rate.

item.title: Claude Platform release notes — December 19th, 2024
item.description: • We've added support for a delete endpoint in the Message Batches API.

item.title: Claude Platform release notes — December 17th, 2024
item.description:
The following features are now available in the Claude API without a beta header:

  • Models API: Query available models, validate model IDs, and resolve model aliases to their canonical model IDs.
  • Message Batches API: Process large batches of messages asynchronously at 50% of the standard API cost.
  • Token counting API: Calculate token counts for Messages before sending them to Claude.
  • Prompt Caching: Reduce costs by up to 90% and latency by up to 80% by caching and reusing prompt content.
  • PDF support: Process PDFs to analyze both text and visual content within documents.

We also released new official SDKs:

  • Java SDK (alpha)
  • Go SDK (alpha)

item.title: Claude Platform release notes — December 4th, 2024
item.description:

  • We've added two new Last used at and Cost columns and the ability to sort by any column on the API keys page of the Developer Console.

item.title: Claude Platform release notes — November 21st, 2024
item.description: • We've released the Admin API, allowing users to programmatically manage their organization's resources.

item.title: Claude Platform release notes — November 20th, 2024
item.description:
• We've updated our rate limits for the Messages API. We've replaced the tokens per minute rate limit with new input and output tokens per minute rate limits. Read more in Rate limits.
  • We've added support for tool use in the Workbench.

item.title: Claude Platform release notes — November 13th, 2024
item.description: • We've added PDF support for all Claude Sonnet 3.5 models. Read more in PDF support.

item.title: Claude Platform release notes — November 6th, 2024
item.description: • We've retired the Claude 1 and Instant models. Read more in Model deprecations.

item.title: Claude Platform release notes — November 4th, 2024
item.description: • Claude Haiku 3.5 is now available on the Claude API as a text-only model.

item.title: Claude Platform release notes — November 1st, 2024
item.description:
• We've added PDF support for use with the new Claude Sonnet 3.5. Read more in PDF support.
  • We've also added token counting, which allows you to determine the total number of tokens in a Message prior to sending it to Claude. Read more in Token counting.

item.title: Claude Platform release notes — October 22nd, 2024
item.description:
• We've added Anthropic-defined computer use tools to our API for use with the new Claude Sonnet 3.5. Read more in Computer use tool.
  • Claude Sonnet 3.5, our most intelligent model yet, just got an upgrade and is now available on the Claude API. Read more in the Claude Sonnet documentation.

item.title: Claude Platform release notes — October 8th, 2024
item.description:
• The Message Batches API is now available in beta. Process large batches of queries asynchronously in the Claude API for 50% less cost. Read more in Batch processing.
  • We've loosened restrictions on the ordering of user/assistant turns in our Messages API. Consecutive user/assistant messages will be combined into a single message instead of erroring, and we no longer require the first input message to be a user message.
  • We've deprecated the Build and Scale plans in favor of a standard feature suite (formerly referred to as Build), along with additional features that are available through sales. Read more in our API pricing information.

item.title: Claude Platform release notes — October 3rd, 2024
item.description: • We've added the ability to disable parallel tool use in the API. Set disable_parallel_tool_use: true in the tool_choice field to ensure that Claude uses at most one tool. Read more in Parallel tool use.

item.title: Claude Platform release notes — September 10th, 2024
item.description: • We've added Workspaces to the Developer Console. Workspaces allow you to set custom spend or rate limits, group API keys, track usage by project, and control access with user roles. Read more in our blog post.

item.title: Claude Platform release notes — September 4th, 2024
item.description: • We announced the deprecation of the Claude 1 models. Read more in Model deprecations.

item.title: Claude Platform release notes — August 22nd, 2024
item.description: • We've added support for usage of the SDK in browsers by returning CORS headers in the API responses. Set dangerouslyAllowBrowser: true in the SDK instantiation to enable this feature.

item.title: Claude Platform release notes — August 19th, 2024
item.description: • 8,192-token outputs on Claude Sonnet 3.5 are out of beta and no longer require the max-tokens-3-5-sonnet-2024-07-15 header.

item.title: Claude Platform release notes — August 14th, 2024
item.description: • Prompt caching is now available as a beta feature in the Claude API. Cache and re-use prompts to reduce latency by up to 80% and costs by up to 90%.

item.title: Claude Platform release notes — July 15th, 2024
item.description: • Generate outputs up to 8,192 tokens in length from Claude Sonnet 3.5 with the new anthropic-beta: max-tokens-3-5-sonnet-2024-07-15 header.

item.title: Claude Platform release notes — July 9th, 2024
item.description:
• Automatically generate test cases for your prompts using Claude in the Developer Console.
  • Compare the outputs from different prompts side by side in the new output comparison mode in the Developer Console.

item.title: Claude Platform release notes — June 27th, 2024
item.description:
• View API usage and billing broken down by dollar amount, token count, and API keys in the new Usage and Cost tabs in the Developer Console.
  • View your current API rate limits in the new Rate Limits tab in the Developer Console.

item.title: Claude Platform release notes — June 20th, 2024
item.description: • Claude Sonnet 3.5, our most intelligent model yet, is now available across the Claude API, Amazon Bedrock, and Vertex AI.

item.title: Claude Platform release notes — May 30th, 2024

item.title: Claude Platform release notes — May 10th, 2024
